Legal Standards.name: Water Right Decision 1641 (D-1641)
Legal Standards.note: Main regulatory instrument that puts Bay-Delta salinity objectives into enforceable SWP/CVP permit and license terms, including export-area salinity at the SWP export intake and municipal/industrial salinity (chloride) limits at export conveyance locations.

Legal Standards.name: Bay-Delta Water Quality Control Plan (Bay-Delta Plan)
Legal Standards.note: Water quality standards basis (beneficial uses + objectives); D-1641 is the implementation vehicle for SWP/CVP. The Plan explicitly frames these objectives as Clean Water Act 'water quality standards.'

Legal Standards.name: Federal Clean Water Act (CWA)
Legal Standards.note: Bay-Delta objectives are treated as CWA water quality standards, and EPA has an oversight/approval role for state standards.

Tier 1.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity <900 uS/cm for all 12 months per year in 95% of years.

policies.note: Meets (and is better than) the D-1641 Export Area EC objective at the SWP intake: 1.0 mmhos/cm (1,000 uS/cm) monthly average (Oct-Sep) at West Canal at mouth of Clifton Court Forebay.

Strongly supports meeting the D-1641 municipal & industrial chloride objective (250 mg/L) that applies to West Canal (CCF) and Delta-Mendota Canal at Tracy (the Jones pathway). (Your indicator is EC, while the legal numeric objective is chloride.)

policies.policy_name: Bay-Delta Water Quality Control Plan (Bay-Delta Plan)
policies.note: Generally consistent with the Bay-Delta Plan's purpose of protecting beneficial uses and managing salinity via project operations.
Implication: Under Tier 1, export water quality would be in the 'compliant/low-salinity' range for the key Bay-Delta/D-1641 export-related salinity objective (EC at CCF).

Tier 2.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity 900-1600 uS/cm for >=10 months per year in 95% of years.

policies.note: D-1641 Export Area EC objective (SWP/CCF) is violated in any month where the monthly average exceeds 1,000 uS/cm. The legal objective is 1.0 mmhos/cm at West Canal at mouth of Clifton Court Forebay.
Because your Tier 2 range goes up to 1,600 uS/cm, Tier 2 includes many plausible months above the legal 1,000 uS/cm objective.

D-1641 municipal/industrial chloride objective (250 mg/L) at export conveyance locations (West Canal/CCF and DMC at Tracy). Tier 2 doesn't automatically prove chloride exceedance, but it implicates this objective because D-1641 explicitly ties the chloride objective to both export pathways.
Once the D-1641 EC export objective is exceeded, the SWP/CVP are in a posture of noncompliance with permit/license terms that "ensure ... export area [objectives] ... are met."

Tier 3.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity >1600 uS/cm for >=2 months in any year, or occurs in >5% of years at either site.

policies.note: D-1641 Export Area EC objective (1,000 uS/cm monthly average at West Canal/CCF) would be violated for any month in the >1,600 uS/cm range (since it is well above 1,000 uS/cm).

policies.policy_name: Bay-Delta Water Quality Control Plan (Bay-Delta Plan)
policies.note: Tier 3 also strongly suggests broader salinity-control failure relative to Bay-Delta standards implemented through D-1641 (salinity managed through "flows and diversions").

D-1641 municipal & industrial chloride objective at West Canal/CCF and DMC at Tracy (again: EC is not the legal chloride metric, but Tier 3 indicates high salinity that makes the chloride objective more likely to be stressed).

D-1641 contains explicit Executive Director reporting/enforcement evaluation language for exceedances at certain southern Delta salinity stations (not Banks/Jones directly), showing that objective exceedances can trigger reporting and enforcement review: "If ... exceeds the objectives ... shall prepare a report for the Executive Director... [who] will ... recommend ... whether enforcement action is appropriate."
Why this matters for your tiers: Tier 3 is squarely in the realm where D-1641 objective exceedances are not occasional-they become a recurring compliance condition.

Tier 4.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity >2500 uS/cm for >=2 months in any year.

policies.note: D-1641 Export Area EC objective (1,000 uS/cm monthly average at West Canal/CCF) is violated by a very large margin.

policies.policy_name: Bay-Delta Water Quality Control Plan (Bay-Delta Plan)
policies.note: This tier is also clearly inconsistent with the Bay-Delta Plan's framing of salinity objectives as part of a standards package protecting beneficial uses via project operations.

Strong implication that the D-1641 chloride objective (250 mg/L) at West Canal/CCF and DMC at Tracy is at heightened risk (again, because the legal metric is chloride, not EC, but Tier 4 salinity is extreme).

Governing Agencies.name: California State Water Resources Control Board (SWRCB)
Governing Agencies.note: Adopts Bay-Delta Plan objectives and enforces them through water-right permits/licenses (D-1641).

Governing Agencies.name: California Department of Water Resources (DWR)
Governing Agencies.note: Operates SWP Banks Pumping Plant/Clifton Court Forebay; assigned responsibility under D-1641 for SWP compliance.

Governing Agencies.name: U.S. Bureau of Reclamation (USBR)
Governing Agencies.note: Operates CVP Jones Pumping Plant/Tracy; assigned responsibility under D-1641 for CVP compliance.

Governing Agencies.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)
Governing Agencies.note: Federal oversight role; Bay-Delta objectives are treated as CWA water quality standards requiring EPA approval.

Governing Agencies.name: Fish Agencies (CDFW, USFWS, NMFS)
Governing Agencies.note: Consulted for export operations; D-1641 includes consultation requirements for certain export operations.
